dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal-lateral region with high-contrast transitions from dark charcoal outer perimeters to light-grey/white interiors; most prominent structures exhibit non-uniform edge thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, bright-white localized pixel clusters along the lower ventral-lateral edge; moderate density of larger, diffused light-grey blobs across the upper mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three prominent macro-annuli in the mid-torso form an obtuse scalene triangle; a series of five high-intensity blobs along the lower-left edge form a linear-curvilinear chain.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent high-contrast white keratinous claws visible on the folded pectoral flipper; distinct light-intensity patches on the posterior flipper margins.
